_comment: Platform fixtures of the GUI tests: platform-prepare.sh creates what is missing and removes it after the run;
generate-config.sh takes the names from here.
tool_groups/tools: in the first docker registry; tools are registered from images that already exist in the registry
(deploy/docker/cp-tests, cp-tools). settings = the tool defaults (spec.json of the image).
A tool registered already gets the settings anyway. A tool exactly as a docker push registers it (cpu 0mi,
ram 0Gi, nothing else set) is taken over: it also gets cpu 1000mi / ram 1Gi and is unregistered after the run,
with its tool group if the push created it (no description, only tools of the run). Other tools get their
previous settings back after the run. Tools with empty settings here are never taken over.
role_user_group: group of the test users (e2e.ui.role.user). registry_mask is granted to it on the registry:
READ allow + WRITE deny + EXECUTE allow = 1 + 8 + 16 = 25 (what RoleModelTest expects and restores).
anonymous_user: a user with ROLE_ANONYMOUS_USER for the anonymous access check (created if no such user exists).
default_instance_type: instance type of the tests runs (e2e.ui.default.instance.type).
sync_storage: the storage StorageSynchronizationTest unregisters is a storage of 'owner' (the user of the storage
synchronization service of the deployment: set it, or set e2e.ui.sync.storage.* in the overrides) with a
permission of a group matching 'permission_pattern' (regex, case-insensitive).
deactivate_blocking_notifications: blocking system notifications cover the UI in every fresh test browser:
they are deactivated for the run (state only, the creation date is kept) and activated back afterwards.
